scenario: A threat-intelligence hit is associated with an outbound connection from an approved internal security scanner performing an authorized vulnerability scan.
required_evidence: The destination generated a threat-intelligence match.
The source host is an approved internal security scanner.
The connection is associated with a vulnerability-scanning action.
The scan is associated with an authorized scan job.
Asset inventory confirms the source host is an approved security scanner.
forbidden_conclusions: Do not classify the connection as malicious solely because of the threat-intelligence match.
Do not infer compromise of the security scanner without corroborating evidence.
Do not ignore the authorized security-scanning context.

scoring_notes.correct_outcome: The system should recognize the threat-intelligence hit but classify the activity as authorized security scanning.
scoring_notes.evidence_requirement: The system should correlate the threat-intelligence result with scanner identity, scan activity, authorization, and asset inventory.
scoring_notes.uncertainty_requirement: High confidence is appropriate because multiple independent telemetry sources explain the apparent threat.
scoring_notes.unsupported_claim_penalty: Treating the threat-intelligence hit alone as proof of compromise should be penalized.
